d: A reptilian humanoid of mature appearance with pale mint-green skin and a slender build. The entity has glowing neon-yellow eyes with no pupils and pale platinum-blonde hair that falls in straight, shoulder-length locks framing a face with a wide, toothy grin. The outfit consists of a dark purple hooded cloak over a long, flowing gown of pale green and deep navy blue, featuring a gold-trimmed bodice. Signature details include a large, segmented skeletal serpent with glowing neon-green joints and eyes that coils around the body and rests over the shoulder, alongside dark metallic bands on the wrists. BODY COLOR: pale mint-green LEGS: plantigrade, hidden beneath the gown
